name: writing
description: Text workbench on the local LLM: summarize (any length), paraphrase/rewrite (formal, casual, simpler), bullet points from text, expand/elaborate, fix grammar and tone, draft an email from bullet points, write a social post or blog outline from a topic. Everything stays on this PC.
route: summarize this text, paraphrase this, rewrite in formal tone, make bullet points from, expand this, fix the grammar, tone check, draft an email saying, write a post about, blog outline for
